title: Set project agent instructions
description: Set the project's agent instructions: markdown that PostHog cloud agents load as their user-level AGENTS.md in every eligible Tasks run on the project, including autonomous runs such as loops and scouts. Requires project admin. Replaces the stored text; send an empty string to clear. Read the current text with tasks-config-list first, and send the full new text, not a diff.
